item.title: 9/11 Victim Barbara Keating Finally Laid to Rest
item.description: Barbara Keating died on a hijacked plane that struck the World Trade Center. Her remains were identified last year.

item.title: U.S. Doctor Treats Ebola's Youngest Victims
item.description: Dr. Rupa Narra, a U.S. pediatrician, traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo to care for stricken children.

item.title: The 9/11 attacks and the remaking of national security
item.description: The Sept. 11 attacks introduced a new type of national security threat, prompting the creation of a new security framework to address it.

item.title: Fossil feather may explain why some birds survived the asteroid
item.description: A well-preserved fossil feather could shed light on why certain birds survived the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs, while others did not.
